source_text: In Manoka, the level of deltamethrin resistance increased from December 2013 (88 % mortality) to April 2014 (48 % mortality).
By contrast in Youpwe, deltamethrin resistance decreased from December 2013 (58 % mortality) to April 2014 (77 % mortality)
